about.title: About
about.heading: About SaaStainedNumbers
about.subtitle: Free, mathematically verified calculators for SaaS founders, operators, and builders.
about.mission: Our mission is to make financial and business mathematics accessible to everyone. We believe that the tools to model, plan, and understand your business should be free, open, and available to all — not locked behind paywalls or enterprise contracts.
about.whoWeAre: We're a small team of engineers, mathematicians, and SaaS operators who got tired of paying for simple calculators. Every calculator on this site is built from first principles, mathematically verified, and benchmarked against real industry data.
about.editorial: All calculators are developed using standard mathematical and financial formulas. Every formula is documented alongside a worked example. Industry benchmarks are sourced from publicly available data, published research, and reputable industry reports. We cite our sources and update them regularly.
about.freeModel: SaaStainedNumbers is supported by non-intrusive display ads and contextual affiliate links within calculator FAQ sections. We never sell user data, never require sign-up, and never put calculators behind a paywall. Embeds are completely ad-free.
about.haveQuestions: Have questions or suggestions? We'd love to hear from you.
